solutions.title: Check every window
solutions.strategy: Grow every start position while tracking the most frequent character in that window.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every start can extend across the remaining string.

spaceComplexity.explanation: A fixed alphabet frequency array is stored.

solutions.title: Sliding window
solutions.strategy: Maintain the largest frequency in the current window and shrink when replacements needed exceed k.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each boundary moves only to the right.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Counts are stored for the alphabet.
